name: luxury-product-reveal
description: A pure-product cinematic showcase pattern for premium physical goods — perfumes, jewelry, skincare, spirits, watches — where no human persona is needed and the product itself is the hero. Uses warm golden-hour lighting, shallow depth of field, slow graceful camera movement, and richly saturated natural environments to create a fragrance-commercial aesthetic that reads as high-end editorial. Hook is a slow atmospheric immersion reveal (product nestled in nature) rather than a verbal or text-drive
author: Official
